title: Settlement ratio for positive projecting conduits
latex: r_{SD}=\frac{\text{Settlement of critical plane}-\text{settlement of top of conduit}}{\text{Compression of height of column H of embankment}}=\frac{(S_m+S_g)-(S_f+d_c)}{S_m}
readable: Settlement ratio r_SD = (Settlement of critical plane - settlement of top of conduit) / (Compression of height of column H of embankment) = [(S_m + S_g) - (S_f + d_c)] / S_m

symbols.definition: Height of top of conduit above adjacent natural ground surface (initial) or the bottom of a wide trench
where p is the projection ratio and Bc is the outside width of conduit
Compression column of height H of embankment
Settlement of natural ground adjacent to the conduit
Settlement of the bottom of conduit and
Deflection of conduit or shortening of its vetical height under load.

applicability: When (S_m+S_g) > (S_f+d_c), r_SD is positive, shearing forces act downwards, and load on conduit equals weight of critical prism plus shear force. When (S_m+S_g) < (S_f+d_c), r_SD is negative and shear acts upward. When r_SD × p = 0, the plane of equal settlement coincides with the critical plane and there are no shearing forces.
notes: Transcriber note: printed "vetical" and the printed H definitions are retained; no symbol repair is made.
